why.en: Public profile details can reveal a surprisingly complete picture of you and may help strangers with profiling, targeted scams, social engineering, identity theft, or locating your real-world connections. Restricting visibility reduces unnecessary exposure.

tradeoffs.en: People outside your chosen audience may know less about you, making it slightly harder for old acquaintances, colleagues, or people with shared backgrounds to recognize and find you.

en: Tap the 3 line menu on the top left
Tap each personal detail you want to limit
Make it at least "Friends of friends"
